Time
To: [contact omitted] Daniel Stolkowski
This looks great, thanks. Made a few tiny changes:
"Information Disorder and Its Threat to Democracy"
The Office of Security (SEC) and Bureau for Development, Democracy and Innovation, Center for
Democracy, Human Rights and Governance (DDI/DRG) invites you to join us for a discussion on mis- dis-
and mal-information and its threat to democracy with Dr. Daniel Rogers, the Co-Founder and Executive
Director at the Global Disinformation Index, an NGO that aims to catalyze change in the tech industry to
disincentivize the creation and dissemination of online disinformation.
Dr. Rogers is a physicist, an author, and an expert in cryptography, cybercrime, disinformation, and security.
He currently teaches in the Cybercrime and Global Security Masters Program at New York University and
serves as a Technical Advisor for the United Nations Development Programme. His presentation will
highlight the complexities of defining disinformation and discuss tangible ways to counter it.
This presentation is co-sponsored by DDI/DRG, which recently released USAID's Disinformation Primer,
and is part of the quarterly SEC Guest Speaker Series which aims to help all USAID staff better understand
security-related issues impacting our work.
On Tue, Dec 14, 2021 at 10:21 AM Daniel Stolkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Danny,
Please review and let me know what you think. We welcome any changes.
This will be sent to thousands of people, so feel free to edit where you wish.
Thanks,
Daniel
